scope: Owner-reported feminine pashmina hair coverage and hairstyle identity defects
method: Reopened actual catalogue GLBs. All eight feminine styles: uncovered, pashmina assembly, and covered hair with cloth hidden. Identical front, three-quarter, profile and rear cameras; 96 matched renders.
findings: Covered crowns contain extensive bare-looking areas. Inherited crown fitting and subsequent clearance projection have pressed much of the hair inside the head surface. This was not a deliberate bald hairstyle.
Bob, Straight, Curls and Side sweep lose rooted front/temple volume, leaving an unnaturally flat narrow band above the forehead.
248 replaced visible Straight, Curls and Side sweep lengths with nearly shared generic lock construction. Curly wave form and Side sweep framing are not faithfully retained.
Box braids has an abrupt horizontal transition from clipped upper braids into sparse replacement face braids. Rear lengths read as an appended short curtain.
Ponytail uses a much smaller and flatter replacement low tail. Its exposed form differs from the selected uncovered tail.
The previous 248 self review overstated visual success. Clearance, export counts and protected-neighbor checks did not establish coverage or hairstyle identity.
repair_requirements: Start from intact uncovered hairstyles and preserve their visible strand geometry, curl wavelength, braid pattern, gloss, framing and length hierarchy.
Keep rooted coverage outside the actual retained head surface. Do not use stale ellipsoid supports or push hair beneath skin to solve cloth intersections.
Author localized concealed root/gather adjustments and fit the cloth to broad hair volume without imprinting every strand or breaking accepted front crossings.
Give each hair exit a continuous origin and natural layering. Avoid blunt eye-level cuts, detached front strings and a uniform row of replacement tips.
Require matched uncovered/covered comparisons, temporary cloth-hidden views, enlarged hair exits and fresh GLB review before calling a repair successful.
status: Audit complete; hair fitting requires repair. No replacement model is claimed by this audit.
protected: Uncovered hair, accepted front crossings, body, face, wardrobe, palette and studio.
